Version 1.1.0

- Added comprehensive SKILL.md with detailed usage guidelines, trigger conditions, component index, documentation links, and example code.
- Provides quick access and references for all Element UI Vue2 components, organized by category.
- Includes step-by-step usage samples for typical scenarios, such as form and button components.
- Lists guides for installation, customization, internationalization, and more to aid users in building Vue 2.x desktop applications.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- No changes made to functionality or documentation.

Initial release of the element-ui-vue2 skill.

- Enables developers to access Element UI desktop component library for Vue 2.x applications.
- Automatically invokes for scenarios involving el- components, forms, tables, dialogs, navigation, and other UI elements.
- Provides a quick index of all supported Element UI components and their documentation links.
- Includes basic usage examples for core components like buttons and forms.
- Offers guides for installation, theming, internationalization, and other best practices.
